What Is a Kiro Agent Hook?

This feature runs Kiro without you even asking.
An agent hook is an event-triggered background automation.
It fires on things like a file save, create, or delete.
Set it once, and it quietly does the work every time.

Episode 36 of theAIgurukul's free Kiro series, a daily short on AWS's agentic IDE. Subscribe for the next one.
